title.en: An Act to Appropriate the Sum of Fifty thousand Pesos for the Maintenance of and Aid to the Government Agricultural Colonies.

text.en:
There is hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, the sum of fifty thousand pesos, which shall accrue and be added to the rice colonization and
plantation fund under the provisions of Act Numbered Twenty-two hundred and fifty-four.

The funds hereby appropriated shall be disbursed and expended for the Government agricultural
colonies by the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
